name: ESP32 iPhone Agent (Handsy)
description: Controls a real iPhone through a $7 ESP32 board, so an AI vision model can tap, swipe, and type in any iOS app from an iPhone app, a CLI, or an MCP server.

skills.name: Screenshot the iPhone
skills.description: Captures the current iPhone screen from the board's AirPlay mirror so a vision model can decide on the next action.

skills.name: Tap and Swipe
skills.description: Taps, long-presses, and swipes on the iPhone screen through the board's USB mouse, with AssistiveTouch turning clicks into taps.

skills.name: Type Text and Press Keys
skills.description: Types text and presses keys and buttons on the iPhone through the board's USB keyboard; keyboard input from the CLI is ASCII only.

skills.name: Replay Runs
skills.description: Replays a finished run step by step on the phone with the taps and swipes drawn on top, and exports the trace for review.
